sources_considered.why: NASA's record contains the abstract of an independent 1992 experimental paper on neural-network extrapolation.
The July 2024 version evaluates multiple contemporary models and prompting methods on altered mathematics problems.

evidence_items.publisher: NASA Technical Reports Server; IEEE conference paper by Haley and Soloway
evidence_items.locator: Abstract of Extrapolation limitations of multilayer feedforward neural networks
evidence_items.explanation: The abstract reports experiments on four functions that found extrapolation limitations in backpropagation networks. This establishes a documented 1990s difficulty, not an impossibility theorem covering every neural architecture.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1, summary of findings; Sections 5.2 and 5.4
evidence_items.explanation: GSM-Plus evaluates 25 models and four prompting techniques, documenting persistent weaknesses on altered problems. Its successful numerical substitutions and paraphrases qualify the breadth of the difficulty but do not negate its persistence.

unresolved_gaps: The studies use different tasks and architectures, so they cannot measure whether the difficulty became more or less severe.
